data.one_liner: Unicode normalization for Dart supporting NFC, NFD, NFKC, and NFKD forms.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions for Unicode normalization (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD) based on the Unicode Standard. It is a Dart port of the walling/unorm library.
use_when: You need to normalize Unicode strings to specific forms (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD).
You are processing text input that may have different Unicode representations for identical characters.
avoid_when: You do not work with multi-language text or complex Unicode character compositions.
strengths: Supports multiple Unicode normalization forms: NFC, NFD, NFKC, and NFKD.
weaknesses: Limited to Unicode normalization functions only.
